svg.text: RETRO ESCALATION // OPEN SOURCE COMBATLOG READER
A data-first Command Console frontend for the STO-OSCR combat-log parser.
One console, four rail presets, custom palettes. Parser truth stays upstream.
RAIL PRESETS // SAME CONSOLE, YOUR COLORS
Fast answers. Deep investigation on demand.
Simple view opens on core telemetry and live weighted-line graphs.
Advanced adds metric lenses, filters, time cuts, and tree drill-down.
Windows ZIP · Linux portable · PyPI / pipx
Portable packages keep settings beside the executable; pipx installs
upgrade in place. GPL-3.0 community frontend — source included.
CUSTOM PALETTES // LIVE APPEARANCE APPLY // DISPLAY-ONLY WORKBENCH
SIX MODES // SUMMARY METER ROWS - GROUPED GRIDS - ADVANCED FULL MATRIX // COPY & UPLOAD INHERITED
GPL-3.0 COMMUNITY FRONTEND // STO-OSCR PARSER UNMODIFIED // COMMAND CONSOLE IS THE DEFAULT EXPERIENCE
